topic: Relative class and spec damage strength
content: Use these as approximate opinion-based placements, not an official or fixed list. S tier: Order of the Emperor; Full Moon Harvester; Berserker's Technique; Brawl King Storm; Remaining Energy; First Intention; Predator; Lunar Voice. A tier: Hellfire Successor; Deathblow; Energy Overflow; Mayhem; Empress's Grace; Taijutsu; Esoteric Flurry; Hunger; Demonic Impulse; Shock Training; Night's Edge; Igniter; Peacemaker. B tier: Time to Hunt; Death Strike; Ferality; Master Summoner; Evolutionary Legacy; Robust Spirit; Punisher; Enhanced Weapon; Surge; Pinnacle; Asura's Path; Dreadful Roar; Arthetinean Skill. C tier: Reflux; Control; Gravity Training; Esoteric Skill Enhancement; Judgment; Rage Hammer; Lone Knight; Barrage Enhancement; Shining Knight; Wind Fury; Loyal Companion; Communication Overflow. D tier: Perfect Suppression; Firepower Enhancement; Phantom Beast Awakening; Drizzle; Pistoleer; True Courage; Combat Readiness. Parent-class mappings: Gunlancer = Lone Knight or Combat Readiness; Berserker = Berserker's Technique or Mayhem; Destroyer = Gravity Training or Rage Hammer; Slayer = Predator or Punisher; Arcanist = Order of the Emperor or Empress's Grace; Souleater = Full Moon Harvester or Night's Edge; Breaker = Brawl King Storm or Asura's Path; Deathblade = Remaining Energy or Surge; Wardancer = First Intention or Esoteric Skill Enhancement; Reaper = Lunar Voice or Hunger; Striker = Deathblow or Esoteric Flurry; Soulfist = Energy Overflow or Robust Spirit; Scrapper = Taijutsu or Shock Training; Shadowhunter = Demonic Impulse or Perfect Suppression; Sorceress = Igniter or Reflux; Gunslinger = Peacemaker or Time to Hunt; Sharpshooter = Death Strike or Loyal Companion; Wildsoul = Ferality or Phantom Beast Awakening; Summoner = Master Summoner or Communication Overflow; Machinist = Evolutionary Legacy or Arthetinean Skill; Deadeye = Enhanced Weapon or Pistoleer; Glaivier = Pinnacle or Control; Artillerist = Barrage Enhancement or Firepower Enhancement; Aeromancer = Wind Fury or Drizzle. When asked about a parent class, compare both specs instead of assigning the parent one exact placement.
